The PSI, Mahalakshmi Layout P.S has submitted the Charge Sheet against the accused No.1 to 3 for the offences punishable Under Secs.420, 508 and 511 r/w Sec. 34 of IPC.
C.C.2902/2015 2.
The brief facts of the Prosecution case are as follows:

That on 07.07.2014 at about 11 A.M while C.W.1 was proceeding by walk, the accused No.1 to 3 came in a car bearing No. KA-20-Z- 3342 and introduced themselves to C.W.1 and coaxed C.W.1 to show them houses with black money and that they would do black magic and take out the black money and give him Rs.250 crores and for that he had to give them Rs.1,000/- for the puja expenses.
C.W.1 gave the accused persons Rs. 1,000/- and took them to third floor of Punya Hospital, Kurubarahalli Main road and left them there and at about 12.45 P.M.
The accused persons started doing puja by spreading all the articles.

At about 4.15P.M the C.W.1, 4 and 5 doubted the accused persons by seeing the puja done and surrounded the accused and questioned the accused persons, then the Arun vs Halim Junaid on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111559357/
2 accused persons admitted that they are cheating people on the pretext of doing black magic, by taking money from the people and thereby the accused persons have committed the offences punishable U/Sec. 420, 508 and 511 r/w Sec 34 of IPC.
C.C.2902/2015 3.

sentences.text: On the basis of the Statement of CW-1, the Mahalakshmi Layout Police have registered a case under Crime No.188/2014 for the offences punishable U/Secs. 420, 508, 511 r/w Sec. 34 of Indian Penal Code against the accused persons and submitted the FIR before the court.

Thereafter the investigating officer visited the spot and drawn the spot mahazar and recorded the statement of witnesses on completion of the investigation, the Charge Sheet has been filed against the accused No.1 to 3 for the offences punishable Under Secs.420, 508, 511 r/w Sec. 34 of Indian Penal Code.
On the receipt of the police report, this court has taken cognizance for the said offences.
4. On appearance of the accused No.1 and 3 they were released on bail.
Accused No.2 remained absent and as such case against accused No.2 is ordered to split up and a separate charge sheet is registered against accused No.2.
The copies of prosecution papers were furnished to the accused No.1 and 3 as contemplated U/Sec.207 of Cr.P.C.
After hearing both the parties, the charge was framed against the accused No.1 and 3 and read over to them.

Accused No.1 and 3 pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried Hence, the matter was posted for evidence.
C.C.2902/2015 5.

In order to bring home the guilt of the accused No.1 and 3, the prosecution has got examined two witnesses as PW-1 and 2, out of total charge sheet witnesses as CW-1 to 8, and got marked three documents as Ex.P1 to P.3.

Since PW-1 and 2 who are the material witnesses turned hostile to the case of the prosecution and since there is no incriminating evidence against the accused No.1 and 3 from the material witnesses, no purpose would be served by issuing summons to rest of the witnesses.
Hence, the evidence of the rest of the witnesses is dropped by rejecting the prayer of the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor.
The statement of the accused No.1 and 3 as required Under Sec.313 of Cr.P.C was dispensed with as there were no incriminating circumstances in the evidence of prosecution witness.

6. I have heard the arguments addressed by the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor and learned advocate for the accused accused No.1 and 3.
7.

On going through the facts and circumstances of the prosecution case, the following points would arise for my consideration :
C.C.2902/2015
POINTS

1 . Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that on 07.07.2014 at about 11 A.M while C.W.1 was proceeding by walk, the accused No.1 and 3 along with accused No.2 (against whom split up case is registered) came in a car bearing No.

3 KA-20-Z- 3342 and introduced themselves to C.W.1 and coaxed C.W.1 to show them houses with black money and that they would do black magic and take out the black money and give him Rs.250 crores and for that he had to give them Rs.1,000/- for the puja expenses.

C.W.1 gave the accused persons Rs. 1,000/-and there by the accused accused No.1 and 3 have committed the offence of "inducing person to believe that he will be rendered an object of the divine displeasure" punishable U/Sec. 508 r/w Sec. 34 of IPC?

2.Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that on the same date at about along with accused No.2 (against whom split up case is registered) to third floor of Punya Hospital, Kurubarahalli Main road and left them there at about 12.45 P.M and the accused No.1 and 3 along with accused No.2 (against whom split up case is C.C.2902/2015 registered) started doing puja by spreading all the articles and at about 4.15P.M the C.W.1, 4 and 5 doubted the accused persons by seeing the puja done and surrounded the accused and questioned the accused persons, then the accused persons admitted that they are cheating people on the pretext of doing black magic and thereby the accused No.1 and 3 have committed the offence of "attempting to commit offence punishable with imprisonment for life or this imprisonment"
punishable U/s 511 r/w Sec.34 of IPC?
3. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that on the above said date, place and time, the accused No.1 and 3 along with accused No.2 (against whom split up case is registered) started doing puja by spreading all the articles and at about 4.15P.M the C.W.1, 4 and 5 doubted the accused persons by seeing the puja done and surrounded the accused and questioned the accused persons, then the accused persons admitted that they are cheating people on the pretext of doing black magic by collecting money from them and cheated them and thereby the accused No.1 and 3 have committed the offence of "cheating" punishable U/s 420 r/w Sec.34 of IPC?
C.C.2902/2015 4. What Order ?
8.

My findings to the above Points are as under:
 Points No.1 to 3 : In the Negative.
Point No.4 :

Points No.1 to 3:-

As these points are interlinked with each other and also similar evidence is led on all these points, I have taken all these points together for common discussion in order to avoid repetition of facts and discussion.

10. It is the allegation that the accused accused No.1 and 3 have committed the offences punishable under Sections 508, 511 and 420 r/w Sec. 34 of IPC.
11.
In order to prove its case, the prosecution has got examined the informant of crime/C.W.1 by the name Arun as P.W.1 and C.W-3- Maruthi as P.W.2.
Out of the documents marked for the prosecution Ex.P1 is the complaint, Ex.P2 is the seizure mahazar and Ex.P.3 is the statement.

P.W.1 in his chief examination has deposed that the accused persons have not introduced themselves to him on 07.07.2014 at about 11.AM and did not tell him that he would give him Rs.250 crores as they will do black magic and extract the black money and and the accused persons have not asked him for money and they have not cheated him by taking money.
He has not lodged complaint against the accused persons.
The police took his signatures on blank paper.
He does not know the contents of Ex.P.1-Complaint and Ex.P.2-Mahazar.
The P.W.1 being the prime witness turned fully hostile to the case of the prosecution.
In the lengthy cross-examination of PW.1 made by learned Sr.A.P.P, nothing worth has been elicited from his mouth to support the case of the prosecution.

He denied the suggestion that he is deposing false evidence as he has compromised the matter with the accused accused No.1 and 3.
13.
C.W.3/P.W.2 in his chief examination has deposed that he signed on Ex.P.2 about 5 years back and he does not know the contents of Ex.P.2 and he has not given statement before the police.
The P.W.2 being a mahazar witness turned fully hostile to the case of C.C.2902/2015 the prosecution.
In the lengthy cross-examination of PW.2 made by learned Sr.A.P.P, nothing worth has been elicited from his mouth to support the case of the prosecution.

14. Now on overall perusal of the evidence and prosecution witnesses as PW-1 and P.W.2, it is pertinent to note that PW-1 and 2 being the material witnesses have not supported the case of the prosecution.
PW-1 prime witness/complainant, P.W.2/mahazar witness denied the entire case of the prosecution.

The PW-1 during the course of his evidence has not at all stated in respect of cheating and by the accused accused No.1 and 3 and they have denied the involvement of the accused accused No.1 and 3 and at the outset, they have denied the entire case of the prosecution.
However, the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor prays to issue summons to other witnesses.

Having considered the facts and circumstances of this case, this court was of the opinion that even if the witnesses were examined, it would be a futile exercise and no lawful purpose would have been served.

As such examination of the prosecution witnesses only for the purpose of completing the procedural aspect and will not serve any judicial purpose and it is a sheer waste of the precious time C.C.2902/2015 of the court.
Therefore, the prayer of the learned APP to issue summons to other witnesses was rejected.

At this stage this court relied upon judgment delivered by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Arun vs Halim Junaid on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111559357/
5 1996 (3) Crimes 84 Sathish Mehra V/s Delhi Administration & another:
wherein at page No.13 the Hon'ble Apex Court held as follows:
"When the judge is fairly certain that thise is no prospect of the case ending in conviction the valuable time of the court should not be wasted for holding a trial only for the purpose of formally completing the procedure to pronounce the conclusion on the future date".

sentences.text: 15. The principle of law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the above case is applicable in this case also.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the present case, it is clear that the prosecution has failed to prove the guilt of the accused No. 1 and 3 beyond all reasonable doubts.

Under these facts and circumstances of the case, the above Points No.1 to 3 are answered in the 'NEGATIVE'.
16.

Point No.4: - In view of the findings of points No.1 to 3, this court proceed to pass the following;
C.C.2902/2015 ORDER Acting U/Sec.248(1) of Cr.P.C. accused accused No.1 and 3 are acquitted of the offences punishable U/Sec. 508, 511, 420 r/w Sec. 34 of Indian Penal Code.
Bail bonds of the accused No.1 and 3 and surety bonds shall stand cancelled.
The bail bond executed under Section 437(A) of Cr.P.C. shall be continued.
There is no order as to disposal of the property in the said case, as split up case is pending against accused no.2.

Keep this entire file in C.C.No. 22786/2024 pending against accused No.2.
